name: genudo-no-connector
description: Genudo skills + agents WITHOUT a bundled MCP connector — for when you connect Genudo yourself: per-project (claude mcp add --transport http genudo https://api.genudo.ai/mcp --scope project), as a custom connector in Claude web/desktop settings, or via the genudo.mcpb extension. Install the `genudo` plugin instead if you want the connector bundled. 22 skills and 6 agents.
